blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The US-led Pax Silica initiative is meant to serve as a backup source of advanced chips in the event of an invasion of Taiwan, Palawan Rep. Jose Alvarez said Thursday. His remarks came amid the Philippines’ involvement in the US-led chips and critical minerals initiative and Washington’s deepening tech rivalry with Beijing.
